description: This file defines the AWS\ACMPCA\ACMPCAClient class which extends AwsClient. It provides method annotations for interacting with the AWS Certificate Manager Private Certificate Authority service, including methods for creating, deleting, describing, issuing, and revoking certificates, among other operations.

classes.name: ACMPCAClient
classes.description: Client class used to connect and interact with the AWS Certificate Manager Private Certificate Authority service. It extends AwsClient and provides methods to manage certificate authorities and certificates.

methods.name: createCertificateAuthority
methods.description: Creates a new private certificate authority.

methods.name: createCertificateAuthorityAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new private certificate authority.

methods.name: deleteCertificateAuthorityAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes a private certificate authority.

methods.name: describeCertificateAuthority
methods.description: Provides details about a specific private certificate authority.

methods.name: describeCertificateAuthorityAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves details about a specific private certificate authority.

methods.name: listCertificateAuthoritiesAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists the private certificate authorities.
